name: Riley
source:
Human illusionist.

Riley considers himself an entertainer, first and foremost. If he didn't have any magical talent, he would be juggling, or singing, or performing acrobatic feats at carnivals or in traveling shows.

But he was born with considerable arcane skills, and to him, that meant he was destined to be the greatest illusionist the world had ever seen.

He has a charming and witty nature and easily wins people over. However, he would gladly sell his own mother for fame, fortune and the riches that come with it.

Riley's gotten into trouble because of that more often than he can count -- and for everybody who happens to be in the same room as him, that means trouble as well...

[From [url=http://www.winterwolves.net/viewtopic.php?f=40&t=3053]Winter Wolves[/url]]
